publications.summary: Begin with S(n), MSS-N, and basic packets; preview advanced routes in the appendix.
Certify a weighted cycle obstruction with matching primal and dual witnesses, and separate safety, progress, and termination.
Check sign gauges and bounded search witnesses in a fixed presentation, and exclude one path pairing on an exact Fock-space example.

Specify detector admission and a controlled evaluation design; four phrase detectors are illustrated on constructed text, and no error rate is measured. An appendix proves three exact lemmas on two-signal gates, quorum thresholds and negative selection, and audits the repository against them.
Separate proposal text, evidence transport, native checking, and admission decisions, with a worked example of refused admission.
Declare an instance, interpret a refusal, change the right object, and replay evidence with a self-contained package.
Retain refused proposals in a hash-chained ledger, state exactly what its checks detect, and describe a catalog of 61 detector candidates as data only.
Connect explanation, prediction, changed-input checks, and a deterministic companion notebook.
Verify the MSS-0 to MSS-1 context maps, census challenges C001 to C050 at a stated commit, and audit recorded retraction traces.
Challenge a claim with explicit properties and changed-input controls, recount one retained proposer-adversary run, and locate where one gate's verdicts come from with four falsifiers.
Check finite-group lattice holonomy exactly, and report two small model pilots with exact counts, what their prompts disclosed, and no model comparison.
